body.purpose: Explains data origin, state, and recovery.

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: A compact explicit light/dark choice; the text names the current theme.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .625rem .875rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: .625rem; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-surface-subtle); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-theme-toggle span { color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: .8125rem; }

components.name: Mock Safety Badge
components.description: Persistent environment truth rather than an interactive filter.
components.css: .ds-safety-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: .375rem .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-warning); border-radius: .375rem; background: var(--color-warning-surface); color: var(--color-warning); font: 750 .75rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; }

components.name: Catalog Filter
components.description: Filters only the catalog items already injected by the backend state contract.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-catalog-filter">Lọc catalog</label><input class="ds-catalog-filter" id="ds-catalog-filter" placeholder="Tên sản phẩm hoặc supplier">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: .375rem; color: var(--color-text); font: 700 .8125rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-catalog-filter { width: min(100%, 24rem); min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .625rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: .625rem; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); caret-color: var(--color-accent); font: inherit; } .ds-catalog-filter::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-catalog-filter:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent); background: var(--color-surface-subtle); } .ds-catalog-filter:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Retry Button
components.description: The only primary action on the catalog surface, shown after a recoverable read error.
components.css: .ds-retry-button { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .625rem .875rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: .625rem; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-contrast); font: 700 1rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-retry-button:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent-hover); background: var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-retry-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-retry-button:active { background: var(--color-disabled); }

components.name: State Panel
components.description: A compact loading, empty, filtered-empty, or error explanation with one clear next step where applicable.
components.html: Catalog mock đang trống.Chưa có sản phẩm tổng hợp nào để hiển thị.
components.css: .ds-state-panel { display: grid; max-width: 42rem; gap: .375rem; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: .75rem; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text-muted); font: 400 1rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-state-panel strong { color: var(--color-text); }

components.name: Availability Chip
components.description: Compact semantic availability status for mock catalog rows.
components.css: .ds-availability { display: inline-flex; min-height: 1.75rem; align-items: center; padding: .25rem .5rem; border-radius: .375rem; background: var(--color-success-surface); color: var(--color-success); font: 700 .8125rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview: The admin is a work surface for reading operational truth, not a promotional destination. Its first viewport establishes product identity, MOCK and READ-ONLY safety, the active environment, and catalog state before offering any secondary control. Light is the deliberate first-load default. Dark is an equally complete operator choice that preserves the same semantic hierarchy. Decoration stays subordinate to scanning, recovery, and keyboard use.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, workmanlike hierarchy with no hero treatment.
Cool neutral surfaces with one restrained blue action accent.
Persistent safety labels and concise Vietnamese operational copy.
Flat-by-default containers, one-pixel borders, and modest corners.
Labeled mobile data cards derived from the desktop table.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates action and focus; it does not decorate passive surfaces.

rules.name: The Light-First Rule
rules.body: A missing, invalid, unreadable, or unsavable preference resolves to light, independent of operating-system theme.

rules.name: The Workmanlike Scale Rule
rules.body: Headings orient; they never grow into marketing copy or dominate the catalog data.

rules.name: The Labels Travel With Data Rule
rules.body: Responsive reflow may change presentation, but it never separates a value from a visible label.

rules.name: The Single Elevation Rule
rules.body: A component uses border/tonal separation or raised shadow according to its role, not both for extra decoration.

dos: Do show MOCK, READ-ONLY, localhost-only, and no-purchase truth before catalog actions.
Do preserve loading, error, empty, filtered-empty, and success states in both themes.
Do use concise Vietnamese labels, visible keyboard focus, and labeled responsive data.
Do use semantic tokens for browser surfaces, including scrollbar, placeholder, and caret.
donts: Don't add a marketing hero, oversized editorial headline, 3D/neon treatment, heavy glass, or looping motion.
Don't infer theme from the operating system or allow storage failure to leave a dark preference active.
Don't hide safety state or operational fields to make a narrow layout look cleaner.
Don't replace backend-injected catalog items with decorative hard-coded products.
